notes: Borsagator fleet registry. 'command' is the child repo's COMMANDS template; {ticker} and {date} are substituted at dispatch time where present. Tools whose pilot command has no {ticker} run their proven pilot target (noted in 'fixed_target'). Borsagator appends an exit-code capture and a summary.json emitter to every command it sets, then restores the child's original COMMANDS afterwards.
